# pidginhost Provider

Manage PidginHost cloud servers and account SSH public keys.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `base_url` (String) API base URL. Defaults to PIDGINHOST_BASE_URL, then https://www.pidginhost.com.
- `token` (String, Sensitive) PidginHost API token. Defaults to the first of the PIDGINHOST_TOKEN, PIDGINHOST_ACCESS_TOKEN and PIDGINHOST_API_TOKEN environment variables that is set.
